settings.name: USE_WHITELIST
settings.description: **Enable Whitelist:** Set to `yes` to enable the whitelist feature.

settings.name: WHITELIST_IP
settings.description: **IP Whitelist:** List of IP addresses or networks (CIDR notation) to allow, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_IP_URLS
settings.description: **IP Whitelist URLs:** List of URLs containing IP addresses or networks to whitelist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_RDNS
settings.description: **rDNS Whitelist:** List of reverse DNS suffixes to allow, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_RDNS_GLOBAL
settings.description: **rDNS Global Only:** Only perform rDNS whitelist checks on global IP addresses when set to `yes`.

settings.name: WHITELIST_RDNS_URLS
settings.description: **rDNS Whitelist URLs:** List of URLs containing reverse DNS suffixes to whitelist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_ASN
settings.description: **ASN Whitelist:** List of Autonomous System Numbers to allow, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_ASN_URLS
settings.description: **ASN Whitelist URLs:** List of URLs containing ASNs to whitelist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_USER_AGENT
settings.description: **User-Agent Whitelist:** List of User-Agent patterns (PCRE regex) to allow, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_USER_AGENT_URLS
settings.description: **User-Agent Whitelist URLs:** List of URLs containing User-Agent patterns to whitelist.

settings.name: WHITELIST_URI
settings.description: **URI Whitelist:** List of URI patterns (PCRE regex) to allow, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_URI_URLS
settings.description: **URI Whitelist URLs:** List of URLs containing URI patterns to whitelist, separated by spaces.

settings.name: WHITELIST_HEADER_NAME
settings.description: **Header name:** Name of a request header that makes the request be whitelisted. Numbered pairs: `_NAME_1` goes with `_VALUE_1`.

settings.name: WHITELIST_HEADER_VALUE
settings.description: **Header value:** PCRE regex the header value must match. Leave empty to match on the header being present, whatever it carries.
